text: Faded fast. I was pleased at how it fit and looked when I put it on my outside table. No need to worry about it blowing around in the wind. However, it faded quickly. I recommend a print if your table is in the sun

product_metadata.title: Covers For The Home Deluxe Elastic Edged Flannel Backed Vinyl Fitted Table Cover - Basketweave (Green) Pattern - Banquet - 8' x 30"
features: ⭐️ Perfect Fit - Our elastic edge design is made to be a snug fit for ANY table with the specified sizing.
⭐️ Great Protection - 100% vinyl with 100% polyester backing on a printed elastic edged table cover helps keep dust off and prevents dents, chips and scratches from forming.
⭐️ Functional - Polyester backing is soft yet durable enough to prevent damage. Waterproof material to prevent damage from spills and accidents.
⭐️ Classic Design - Multiple options; Comes in a wide assortment of designs to blend in with any décor and dress up an old table.
⭐️ Easy to Clean - Just take a damp cloth or sponge and wipe clean. 🚫 NOT MACHINE WASHABLE – DO NOT IRON 🚫
description: Our Elastic Edge Table Cover is designed with vibrant patterns and an elastic edge to hold the cover tight. 100% of the edges of the cover are sewn with elastic which insures that the cover stays on your table. The polyester flocking on the back protects your fine finish on wood tables. Dress up your tables protected from dust and dents with our Deluxe Elastic Edge Table Covers. Our sturdy PEVA vinyl table covers are softer and sturdier than any other covers you’ll find. They are waterproof to withstand spills while also dressing up an old table. Our designs are classic to keep your table stylish while also offering the best reputation of protection. Easily cleaned, just take a damp cloth or sponge and wipe clean. With an array of sizes and designs to fit your need… our Deluxe Elastic Edge Table Covers are sure to be a great fit!
Sizes Available: Small Round – Fits Tables Up to 44” Diameter Large Round – Fits Tables Up to 45” - 56” Diameter Oblong/Oval – Fits Tables Up to 48”W x 68”L Square – Fits Tables Up to 46” Square
